subject: Can't run invariance in a short scale

messages.author: a0364c0d81807191
messages.subject: Can't run invariance in a short scale
parts:
Hi everyone!

I am adapting 4 scales in Brazilian samples. One of them is the Mental Help-Seeking Intention Scale (MHSIS). It has only 3 items, which show high correlation between items in one of the groups. For some reason, we are unable to run the invariance analysis of this scale. Could someone explain why?

Could be an option going straight to the metric? We don't know how to proceed.

I'll leave an attachment with the R syntax.

Thanks a lot already.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Can't run invariance in a short scale
parts:
You have only 3 indicators, so the configural model has df=0.  You can test any nested model that actually applies constraints, but loadings are not comparable (thus, equivalence is not testable) across groups when their scales are not linked across groups.  Latent-response scales can be linked by equating thresholds.  Read the Wu & Estabrook (2016) reference on the ?semTools::measEq.syntax help page, and see the help-page examples.  You can also try searching past posts in this forum about measurement invariance with categorical (binary or ordinal) indicators to read more.
